evals.prompt: Review this SaaS B2B ActionPopover.tsx and action-popover.css component before merge. The button uses `transition: all 350ms ease`, opens on `onClick`, displays a menu animated with `@keyframes openMenu { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }` for 320ms using default `transform-origin: center`, sets `font-weight: 600` on `.menu-item:hover` with no media query guard, leaves `gap: 8px` between items, lacks `prefers-reduced-motion`, and calls `toast('Copied API key')` inside the synchronous Copy button handler.
assertions: Triggers hard vetos veto-01 (transition: all), veto-02 (@keyframes + scale(0) + center transform-origin), and veto-03 (missing prefers-reduced-motion + unwrapped :hover).
Triggers conditional blocks veto-04 (distant toast on synchronous copy) and veto-05 (unreserved font-weight hover shift).
Flags sig-03 for exceeding the <=200ms standard and <=300ms ceiling (350ms button transition and 320ms menu reveal).
Applies Phase A rubric cap of <= 49 (floored at 0 after deductions) and outputs posture BLOCK.

Remediates with explicit compositor transitions (transform, opacity) <=200ms using @starting-style, trigger-bound transform-origin, initial scale 0.93-0.98, mousedown trigger, @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), zero dead list gap, bold ::after width reservation on the label wrapper or color-only hover, and inline trigger checkmark with polite aria-live.

evals.prompt: Audit this mobile capture CaptureSheet.tsx drawer for iOS and Android web. On open it runs `@keyframes slideSheet { from { height: 0; } to { height: 480px; } }` for 550ms, tracks touch dragging via `useState` updating `--drag-offset` CSS variable on the sheet wrapper containing 35 list items, applies `backdrop-filter: blur(36px)` on the overlay, omits `prefers-reduced-motion`, sets `<input>` `font-size: 13px`, and renders a `20px x 20px` close icon button.
assertions: Triggers hard vetos veto-01 (height animation), veto-02 (blocking @keyframes open), and veto-03 (missing prefers-reduced-motion).
Triggers conditional blocks veto-04 (inherited CSS variable --drag-offset mutated during drag across >20 items + React state per frame) and veto-05 (animated blur 36px > 20px).
Flags sig-03 (550ms exceeds even the 500ms iOS sheet exception) and flt-05 for 13px mobile input (iOS Safari auto-zoom) and 20x20px close hit target (<44x44px touch minimum).
Applies Phase A rubric cap <= 49 (floored at 0) and posture BLOCK.

Remediates with transform: translate3d(0, 100%, 0) interruptible transition <=500ms, direct DOM ref style writes with setPointerCapture, release-only dismissal via velocity projection or distance (>=25%), nonlinear upward rubber-banding (UIKit c = 0.55), 500ms scroll-lock debounce, overscroll-behavior: contain, <=20px blur, 44x44px close hit target, and >=16px input font-size.

evals.prompt: Audit this AI IDE CommandContextMenu.tsx component. It already uses cancelable CSS transitions (`transform 140ms ease-out, opacity 140ms ease-out`) with `@starting-style`, `transform-origin: var(--radix-popper-transform-origin)`, initial `scale(0.96)`, `0ms` duration on Cmd+K and keyboard arrow selection, `:focus-visible` box-shadow rings, `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, `>=24px` desktop / `>=44px` touch targets, `tabular-nums`, and a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` fallback. assertions: Triggers zero hard vetos (veto-01, veto-02, veto-03 all pass) and zero hard filter failures (flt-01..flt-05 pass).
Triggers conditional_block veto-05 (-15) for animated blur(28px) exceeding 20px and nested hover submenu missing safe-triangle prediction cone.
Fails high signal sig-05 (-5) for dynamic_blur_radius_px = 28px > 20px.
Computes exact calibrated score S = 100 - 15 - 5 = 80 and maps posture to REVISE (60 <= S < 82 and unresolved conditional_block).

Remediates by lowering animated blur to <=20px (e.g., 12px) and implementing a safe-triangle prediction cone (atan2 with 15-degree angular grace buffer, 2 consecutive invalid move samples, <=16ms throttle, or dynamic clip-path: polygon corridor).
